tests.name: bug_report_order_submission
tests.input: I found a bug when submitting my order
tests.expected_behavior: The flow should route to the bug-report handler, apologize, ask follow-up questions, and explain that a support ticket will be created.
tests.actual_behavior: The flow routed to the BugsReportAgent, returned the label 'bug', asked for reproduction details, error message, device/browser, prior occurrences, and optional screenshot/video, and explained that a support ticket would be created and reviewed.

evidence.output_summary: Apology + follow-up questions + resolution/ticket creation message

tests.notes: DynamoDB persistence was not verified in this trace.

tests.name: platform_faq_order_tracking
tests.input: How do I track my order?
tests.expected_behavior: The flow should route to the platform FAQ handler and answer the question using only the embedded FAQ.
tests.actual_behavior: The flow routed to the platform FAQ handler, returned the order-tracking instructions from the embedded FAQ, and ended successfully.
tests.notes: The response matched the embedded FAQ and remained within the required two-to-three sentence limit.

tests.name: other_birthday_gift_recommendation
tests.input: Can you recommend a birthday gift?
tests.expected_behavior: The flow should route to the other-requests handler and politely redirect the customer to the human support helpline.
tests.actual_behavior: The flow routed to the other-requests handler, explained that birthday gift recommendations were outside its supported platform assistance, and redirected the customer to the human support helpline.
tests.notes: The response correctly handled a request outside the Bug Report and Platform Question categories.
